sport.description: The sport to get the ranking for.

message.content:
LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest players in NBA history. He was born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, and played high school basketball at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School, where he gained national attention as a prodigy. After being selected first overall in the 2003 NBA Draft by the Cleveland Cavaliers, LeBron quickly became a dominant force in the league.

He has won four NBA championships (2012, 2013, 2016, 2020) with the Miami Heat, Cleveland Cavaliers, and Los Angeles Lakers, earning NBA Finals MVP honors each time. LeBron has also earned 19 All‑NBA selections, 18 All‑Defensive Team selections, and 17 NBA All‑Star appearances, along with two Olympic gold medals (2008, 2012). His career averages exceed 27 points, 7 rebounds, and 7 assists per game, and he is known for his versatility, athleticism, and basketball IQ.

Beyond the court, LeBron is a philanthropist, entrepreneur, and media personality. He founded the LeBron James Family Foundation, which opened the I PROMISE School in Akron to support at-risk children. He has produced films and television shows through his company SpringHill Entertainment and has been involved in various business ventures, including a partnership with Nike and ownership stakes in several sports teams.
